pages.text: Collects $(cfg)450$() ml from a donor, standing still ~30 s. Donor loses at most $(cfg)15%%$(). Medicine 3.
Labelled with the donor's type. Transfusion $(cfg)4$() min. Spoils in $(cfg)2$() h out of a fridge; never in a fridge.

$(l)Incompatible blood$(): a $(cfg)10–20$() min reaction — fever, pain, falling pressure, kidney damage; may stop the heart. Stop the transfusion; saline and adrenaline help.$(br2)$(l)Spoiled blood$() looks dark on the icon. It can be transfused, but that means sepsis.
